hook: Agar Chand Gayab Ho Jaye Toh?

points.title: Raatein ekdum andheri
points.text: Chandni khatam, raat mein sirf taare chamkenge.

points.title: Samundar ki lehrein ghat jayengi
points.text: Jwaar-bhata sirf Suraj se, lagbhag ek-tihai reh jayega.

points.title: Earth dagmagane lagegi
points.text: Chand Earth ka jhukaav stable rakhta hai. Uske bina mausam lambe samay mein bigad sakta hai.

takeaway: Chand sirf sundar nahi, Earth ka bodyguard hai.
cta: Follow karo, roz ek naya sawaal
